description: Capture index for the dashboard loader. Only the DVAA `demo aim-ab --json` recordings below are captures. Everything else under captures/contrast/ (runs/contrast.json, runs/run-meta.json, *.proxy.jsonl, standin-inspector.config.json) is a derived artifact, metadata or config, and the loader never parses it. A new *.demo.json in runs/ must be added here; sentinel/dashboard/test/dashboard.test.mjs fails if one is missing.
